desc: Look something up on the web without leaving what you are reading. Lasso handwriting in a note, or select text in a book or PDF, and the selection becomes a web search. Results are fetched and shown as plain text you can read on the page you were already on. Choose the passages worth keeping and they go back into your note: a link to each page you chose, and a second link, named however you like, opening what you kept as text or as a picture of what you read. Nothing is written into a book: the device does not permit a plugin to write while a book is open. Your search words are sent only to the search engine you choose - DuckDuckGo, Wikipedia or Wiby - and to the pages you then open. There is no account and no server of ours. Network access fetches those pages; file access stores the clippings and settings in Document/LookUp.
name: Web Lookup
author: Sparkinman
